'''Suwan'zi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He resided in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], requisitioning weapons to authorized individuals.<ref name="TOR" />
